description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API: any sklearn featurizer plus classifier can be wired in, with probability calibration applied automatically. The default baseline is a calibrated linear SVM.
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; the per-plugin config pins the documented linear_svc baseline (TF-IDF word featurizer + CalibratedClassifierCV-wrapped LinearSVC), slot tagging and confidence thresholds.
